title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The ICSP Programme in Sudan is enhancing access to essential services while reducing vulnerabilities and hunger in the Dilling and El Fasher localities of South Kordofan and North Darfur states. In 2024, the programme reached 60,124 community members, including internally displaced persons in these areas. Primary healthcare facilities strengthened by the programme are now providing critical, life-saving health services to communities in the fragile and conflict-affected areas of Dilling. GOAL builds learning and processes into the health system that reduce or remove barriers to people accessing lifesaving services, including family planning, reproductive health, SGBV survivor services, maternal & newborn care, and nutrition. Local institutions have also been strengthened, improving their preparedness and response capacities to potential shocks and emergencies. Those who have experienced extreme food shortages due to the protracted conflict have not been overlooked, with 5,600 individuals receiving meals for months through program support to local community-based organizations.. OVERALL COUNTRY PROG: Outcome 2: People Have Resilient Health. SPECIFIC OUTCOME: GOAL focuses on health system strengthening with the objective of increasing the number and percentage of health facilities providing quality health services (including nutrition services and WASH facilities), so that health and well-being can improve.
